apps.name: elf-arsenal
apps.release_notes:
Bumps embedded garlic-worker to **v1.1.5**.

Worker changes:
- `copy_dir_recursive` (PS5) + `copy_dir_pfs` (PS4) now check `copy_file` return codes and fail loudly instead of silently truncating.  Encrypt paths bail with an ERROR log + save_unmount if the copy step fails (out of space or otherwise).  Latent hazard closed — server-side saveblocks-headroom already prevents the ENOSPC case in the wild.
- User-Agent bumped from `sonicloader-worker/v1.1.4` -> `sonicloader-worker/v1.1.5` so HTOS-web can distinguish updated vs stale workers in the fleet.

Build pipeline:
- Top-level workflow now rebuilds `payloads/garlic-worker.elf` from `garlic-worker-src/` on every push instead of shipping a stale pre-committed binary.  Future worker source edits flow into the fleet automatically.
